title.zh: Astra for Coding: Why Are We Doing This Again?
title.en: Astra for Coding: Why Are We Doing This Again?

current_state.zh: A critical essay argues that AI coding agents like Astra are optimized for long-horizon task success while being insufficiently penalized for producing poor-quality code, sparking extensive HN discussion on the limits of current agentic coding approaches.
